# Validation report

*Release: rubric 0.1.8, engine 0.1.6, data snapshot 2026-10-24. Generated by `ingest/make_validation_report.py` from the run's own outputs; do not edit by hand. PRD section 17, D7. Methods: `docs/methodology-note.md`, section 6.*

## Summary

- **External validity: not yet tested.** None of the planned comparisons with expert diagnostics has been run, so there is no false rule-out rate yet. The thresholds are uncalibrated.
- **Internal checks pass:** 100 of 100 engine tests; the statsmodels re-estimate of the residuals agrees (largest gap in t 0.030); 1193 of 1193 outputs reproduce from the release.
- **Verdicts:** of 3,472 scored node rows (217 economies), 3,064 (88 percent) are a "cannot tell"; 0 reach an extreme tier.
- **Test 4 kill criterion:** 1 of 3 vectors pass (CH.SKILL); CH.FIN, CH.TIME fail and are shown but not counted.

## 3. Test 4 kill criterion

Each real intensity vector against 99 industry-permuted placebos (seed 20261029). It must beat the placebos' 95th percentile on both: the rank correlation of θ between 2019 and 2024 (stability), and the rank correlation of θ estimated from RCA with θ from export shares.

| Vector | Stability: real | placebo 95th pct | RCA vs share: real | placebo 95th pct | Passes |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| External finance dependence (Rajan-Zingales), N0 and N3 | 0.957 | 0.941 | 0.695 | 0.725 | no, shown only |
| Schooling intensity (Ciccone-Papaioannou), N4 | 0.963 | 0.950 | 0.724 | 0.701 | yes, counted |
| Transport time sensitivity (Hummels-Schaur air share), N6 | 0.944 | 0.861 | 0.501 | 0.528 | no, shown only |

## 4. Coverage

- Nodes that are a data gap for every economy: N2, N7, N8, N11.taxes, N11.crime.
- Economies with no usable indicator: 18 (American Samoa; Channel Islands; Cuba; Eritrea; Gibraltar; Guam; Isle of Man; Liechtenstein; St. Martin (French part); Monaco; Northern Mariana Islands; New Caledonia; Korea, Dem. People's Rep.; French Polynesia; South Sudan; Venezuela, RB; British Virgin Islands; Yemen, Rep.).
- Comparator sets: 31 economies have no aspirational set; 18 have a structural set shorter than ten.
- Engine warnings: 8 (listed in `out/engine-report.json`).

From the Methodology Note, section 6.2. Each will be reported here when run, including any failed kill criterion.

| Phase 0 screening: ten countries with public diagnostics, rubric frozen by hash, pre-registered | Zero adjudicated false rule-outs; "cannot tell" under 40 percent | Two or more adjudicated false rule-outs | not run |

| Prospective, pre-registered comparisons | As the retrospective | As the retrospective | not run |
